### Is the new test's oracle right? (probe `zz-oracle.test.ts`, item code, all 103 exit-bar runs)

`flowNear` is the yardstick of the fix, so this seat checked it against a third formulation. That is the
length-weighted mean of the course's unit segment tangents over [s − w, s + w], clipped segment by segment: "the course
tangent averaged over one channel width upstream and downstream", read literally. Result (`oracle-orig.json`): 103
runs, **948 decks, 0 over 10°**, worst 2.01° against the mean tangent and 2.01° against `flowNear`. The largest angle
between the two oracles is 1.5 × 10⁻⁶°, and between the mean tangent and the site's own `flow` it is also
1.5 × 10⁻⁶°. Every `site.at` is a course vertex. So the test measures the promise as §4.2 S1 (5) states it, and the
item's sites follow it. **CONFIRMED.**

## Verdict: FAIL — one blocker (B-1); every gate is green; nine minor notes go to M4

The item is close to done. Every gate passes, every listed interface and test exists, and the checker's own deck
property holds on all 103 exit-bar runs. One listed promise is not held by any test: a deck that is **not**
perpendicular to the averaged flow passes every listed test (B-1). The fix is one test.

### B-1 (BLOCKER) — the "deck perpendicular to the local flow within ± 10°" test cannot fail on the exit bar's seeds (mutant M07 survives and breaks the promise)

* **The promise.** The listed test is "each deck perpendicular to the local flow within ± 10°". §4.2 S1 (5) defines the
  local flow as "the course tangent averaged over one channel width upstream and downstream", and C-0229 (5) builds it
  that way (`crossings.ts:59–65`).
* **The mutant.** M07 replaces the averaged chord with the course's own next segment
  (`const up = course[v]; const down = course[v + 1];`). It passes all five test files: "Test Files 5 passed",
  exit bar included (`mutants.jsonl`, M07 SURVIVED at stage exitbar).
* **Not equivalent.** My probe `zz-perp.test.ts` measures every deck of the 100 exit-bar seeds against the flow averaged
  over one width, computed independently in the form of `stage.test.ts`'s `flowNear`. On the item's code: 795 decks,
  0 over 10°, worst 2.0°. Under M07: 795 decks, **2 over 10°: "seed 36 bridge:5 12.4°", "seed 85 bridge:3 11.9°"**
  (`perp-orig.json`, `perp-M07.json`). The listed promise breaks, and no listed test notices. **CONFIRMED.**
* **Why no test notices.** `crossings.test.ts`'s `offNormalDeg` measures the deck against `s.flow`, the site's own
  output, so the comparison is circular. `stage.test.ts` measures against an independent `flowNear`, but on one seed
  (seed 2) only, where M07's decks stay within 10°. `exit-bar.test.ts` does not measure the angle.
* **Required change.** Measure each deck against the flow averaged over one channel width, computed independently of
  `siteCrossings` (as `flowNear` does), on every seed of the exit bar. Alternatively, or as well, add a hand-built
  course to `crossings.test.ts` whose next-segment tangent differs from the one-width average by more than 10°, and
  check the deck against the independent average. Either way M07 must fail. No source change is needed.

## The checker's deck property and other probes (`zz-probe.test.ts`; 100 bar seeds and 3 full CITY frames; CONFIRMED)

The item's `checker` line reads: "confirms no L0 edge crosses water and no deck splits a reach's L0 face". All 103 runs
committed, with **0 problems**:

* No L0 edge has one body's water on both sides, and none has land on both sides.
* No edge carries `deck`.
* Each of the 948 decks has its two ends on its own body's shore only (no `margin`, no other body's shore), live and
  pinned. No deck properly crosses any L0 edge, and every deck's midpoint locates in its own body's L0 face. So no
  deck splits a reach's face, and every deck spans water only.
* No body vanished unreported. No seedless polygon part was dropped (an instrumented `partsWithSeeds` counted 0).
* Frame outfalls (1 063): all on the arena's edge, at most one per side per 50 m stretch.
* Bank outfalls (7 374): 7 368 lie within 2 cm of their body's shore chain in the arena; 6 lie up to 22 cm off it
  (note 1).
* Water-face area over ∫ width ds: median 0.9998, range 0.75–1.03. The low end is a tributary whose mouth lies inside
  its river.
